entries.text: TPC-DI row counts now follow the TPC-DI specification's scale unit and historical-load row factors: one scale-factor unit is 5,000 customers (was 50,000), with 5,000 accounts, 500 companies, 800 securities, 130,000 trades, 120,300 cash-balance rows, 120,470 holdings, 541,550 market-history rows and 300,000 watches. Generated data is smaller at every scale factor than before, cached TPC-DI data regenerates once, and TPC-DI results from earlier versions are not comparable with new ones.
